entry.title: string search server
entry.summary:
The Problem
Searching large text files over a network typically means either loading the entire file into memory or shipping the file to the client. Both approaches waste bandwidth and RAM. This project addresses that gap with a dedicated TCP server that performs the search server-side and returns only the matching lines, with SSL for transport security and multiple search strategies to handle different file sizes and query patterns.
